sources.entry: Natural Language Processing in Python by Steven Bird, Ewan Klein, and Edward Loper

summary.name: Natural Language Processing with Python
summary.one_liner: An online, Python 3 edition of the book by Steven Bird, Ewan Klein, and Edward Loper that teaches natural language processing using the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK).
use_cases: learning natural language processing with Python
summary.what_it_does: The page is the online version of the book "Natural Language Processing with Python – Analyzing Text with the Natural Language Toolkit", updated for Python 3 and NLTK 3. It lists 12 chapters plus a preface, bibliography and term index. Chapter topics include language processing and Python basics, accessing text corpora and lexical resources, processing raw text, structured programs, categorizing and tagging words, learning to classify text, extracting information from text, analyzing sentence structure, feature based grammars, sentence meaning, and managing linguistic data. The first edition, published by O'Reilly, is linked separately.
notable: Free online edition updated for Python 3 and NLTK 3
Covers corpora, tagging, classification, information extraction and parsing
Original first edition published by O'Reilly is linked from the page
